'''Bird Droid''' was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] present in [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]]' [[Tomorrowland Starport]].<ref name="ST" /> They built nests and hatched [[Color/Legends|silver]] [[Egg/Legends|eggs]].<ref name="CGSW" /> [[SK-Z38]] was one such droid.<ref name="SWST">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Star Tours (toy line)|pack=SK-Z38|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/sw03stskz38.asp}}</ref>
